name: medq-hybrid
description: Source-grounded medical MCQ practice with a five-option exam engine.

interface.longDescription: MedQ helps medical students create difficult, source-grounded board-style MCQ practice exams from their lecture materials. It validates exactly five distinct options (A–E), presents one question at a time, grades each answer immediately, explains incorrect answers in Iraqi Arabic mixed with English medical terminology, and calculates the final score. Educational use only; not medical advice.
interface.defaultPrompt: Create a difficult five-option medical MCQ exam from my lecture.

prompts: Create a 15-question medical MCQ exam from the lecture I upload.
Make a difficult board-style exam using all the lecture files I attach.
Start a fresh five-option medical MCQ round without repeating previous learning points.

publication.release_notes: MedQ Hybrid 0.6.0 adds a remote MCP exam engine that validates five distinct A-E options, manages encrypted short-lived quiz sessions, grades one answer at a time, returns bilingual explanations for incorrect answers, and calculates final scores. The server does not call an AI API or store exam sessions in a database.
